title: Acha Mazoezi ya Kufikiri Kupita Kiasi 🌀

text.🌀 Stop Overthinking Practice: 🌀 Acha Mazoezi ya Kufikiri Kupita Kiasi
text.I read a book called Stop Overthinking P: Nilisoma kitabu kiitwacho Stop Overthinking Practice. Iliandikwa na Joseph Nguyen. Iliuza nakala za 700,000 nchini Marekani na ilichapishwa katika nchi 33].
text.The content matches the title: do not ov: Maudhui yanalingana na kichwa: usifikirie kupita kiasi.
text.The sentence that hit me the most in the: Sentensi iliyonigusa zaidi kitabuni ni hii. Iliwekwa hapo kama nukuu.
text.“I have missed happiness many times beca: "Nimekosa furaha mara nyingi kwa sababu nilifikiria na kufikiria, lakini sijawahi kuwa na furaha kwa sababu nilifikiria na kufikiria."
text.When I read it, I had nothing but things: Nilipoisoma, sikuwa na chochote ila vitu vilivyonifaa.
text.When I look back at my life, I have far: Ninapotazama nyuma katika maisha yangu, nina nyakati nyingi zaidi ambapo muda ulipita nikiwaza kuliko nyakati ambazo mambo yalikwenda vizuri kwa sababu nilifikiri.
text.I think thinking helps only in areas whe: Nadhani kufikiria husaidia tu katika maeneo ambayo kuna jibu, kama vile muundo na hesabu.
text.If you keep thinking in areas with no an: Ukiendelea kufikiria katika maeneo bila jibu, hupati nyenzo zaidi. Unazunguka tu na kuzunguka mahali pamoja.
text.As philosophers often say, this is an ar: Kama wanafalsafa husema mara nyingi, hili ni eneo ambalo ukweli haupo, kwa hivyo jibu sahihi haliwezi kutoka.
